name: True Grit Redemption

features.name: Wild Transform
features.description: Matching symbols above and below a reel turn wild.

review:
A 6x5 western with a clever matching rule: if the symbol above a reel matches the one beneath it, both turn into wilds. Stacked xNudge wilds on the bottom reel always nudge into view, gaining +1 per step.

xWays reveal two or three matching symbols, and Infectious xWays spread the effect further across the grid. Lots of moving parts, all pointing the same way. Extreme volatility, 20,220x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
